Author: linusfr
Name: Venture Bell
Punchline: Pushes a notification when your retainers get back, even with the game closed.
Description: Sends your retainers' venture completion times to a small self-hosted server, which holds the countdown and pushes a notification when they finish — including when the game is shut down. Reads the timers the game already has; it never assigns, collects or interacts with a retainer. Nothing is sent anywhere until you configure your own server address.
